blocks.en: In the previous two sections, we have considered fundamental solutions for PDEs with constant coefficients. Such fundamental solutions allow the solution of problems of the form $L(D)u=f$, posed on all of space. In practical applications, however, one does not usually want to solve problems posed on all of space; rather one wants to solve PDEs on some domain, subject to certain conditions on the boundary. Green\textquotesingle s functions are the analogue of fundamental solutions for this situation. They can be found explicitly only in very special cases. Nevertheless, the concept of Green\textquotesingle s functions is useful for theoretical investigations. At present, we do not have the methods available to discuss the existence, uniqueness and regularity of Green\textquotesingle s functions for PDEs, and the discussions in this section will to a large extent be formal.
blocks.zh: 在前两节中, 我们考察了常系数偏微分方程的基本解. 这样的基本解使我们能够求解在整个空间上提出的形如 $L(D)u=f$ 的问题. 但在实际应用中, 通常并不希望求解整个空间上的问题; 而是希望求解某个区域上的偏微分方程, 并在边界上施加一定条件. Green 函数是这种情形下基本解的对应物. 只有在很特殊的情形下才能显式求出它们. 尽管如此, Green 函数这一概念对于理论研究仍然有用. 目前尚无可用的方法来讨论偏微分方程 Green 函数的存在性, 唯一性和正则性, 因而本节讨论在很大程度上将是形式的.
